body.statement: For every \(a\in\mathcal A_{\mathrm G}\), the data-driven clip is asymptotically inactive when the propensity is bounded away from zero and is first-order negligible otherwise under \(\text{ass:finite-variance}\). The cross-fitted likelihood construction satisfies \[\sqrt n\{\widehat q_a(\tau)-q_a(\tau)\}=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\mathrm{IF}_a(O_i;\tau)+o_P(1)\] jointly over \(a\in\mathcal A_{\mathrm G}\) and \(\tau\in\mathcal T\), with covariance \(E_P[\mathrm{IF}_a\mathrm{IF}_{a'}^\top]\).
body.justification: The Gaussian branch retains shared first-stage covariance and is now centered at the correct untrimmed quantile.
body.gap: Firpo establishes the regular-overlap result; the present branch allows finite inverse moments without strict overlap and is supporting machinery for mixed regimes.
body.consumer: It supplies the regular component of a QTE whose other arm can have an infinitely divisible limit.
